meta.name: executing-plans
meta.description: Use when you have a written implementation plan to execute in a separate session with review checkpoints

copy.tagline: 按计划分步执行代码任务并设置审查节点
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果手头有详细的实现计划需要分步执行并接受审查
copy.tagline_en: Execute implementation plans step by step with review checkpoints
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you have a detailed implementation plan to execute in stages with review

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会先加载并审查一份书面实施计划，然后按步骤执行每个任务，并在完成后报告结果。
howto.when: 当你给 Claude 一份书面的实施计划，并希望它在一个独立会话中执行时触发。

say.note: Claude 会加载计划并开始审查。

say.text: 按计划执行任务，遇到问题就问我。
say.note: Claude 会严格按步骤执行，遇到阻塞会暂停询问。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude loads and critically reviews a written implementation plan, then executes each task step by step, and reports when complete.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you provide a written implementation plan and ask Claude to execute it in a separate session with review checkpoints.

say_en.note: Claude will load the plan and start reviewing.

say_en.text: Follow the plan and ask me if you hit a blocker.
say_en.note: Claude will strictly follow steps and stop to ask for help when blocked.
